Sentinel SSH_AGENT_PID=999999 is scoped to the test process and cleared for private transport. No login-agent query or SSH server authentication.

Owned helper termination, unrelated process preservation, confirmation No/Yes, no late success/Rebase callbacks, partial remotes/branches-before-tags retained, fresh-token retries and idle Cancel remain verified. New preparation hook is not supplied by these native callers yet.
